EGPProvenance.description:
Provenance of the assertions behind a group. Field-for-field the
`$CMR` provenance shape, so one consumer parses both.

SOURCE.description: Publisher name verbatim as that publisher states it.

SOURCE_DATASET.description: Source dataset or product name verbatim.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source-native row, group, object, or catalogue identifier.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: Source revision, edition, or upstream update marker verbatim.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters. Empty only when the source cannot expose replayable bytes.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Empty means unknown terms, never public
domain and never an implied grant.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text required by the source.

NOTES.description: Source caveats or reconciliation notes; never a substitute for a field.

EGPQuery.description:
The query that generated this group — the wire form of save-search-as-group.
This is generating provenance, not source lineage, so it is a field of its
own and never overloaded onto EGPProvenance.

DIALECT.description:
Query language the TEXT is written in, verbatim and lowercase, e.g.
`flatsql`. A consumer that does not implement the dialect keeps MEMBERS
and never guesses at the text.

TEXT.description: The query text verbatim, exactly as evaluated.

EVALUATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which TEXT was evaluated to
produce MEMBERS.

RESULT_COUNT.description:
Row count the evaluation returned. A consumer whose re-evaluation differs
reports drift; it never silently rewrites the record.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
Dataset or collection epoch the evaluation ran against, when the publisher
can name one.

STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the referenced record, `$` included,
e.g. `$CAT`. Never the union ordinal.

RECORD_ID.description: The referenced record's publisher-stable identifier, verbatim.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
Denormalized fast key for catalogued space objects. 0 means absent, which
is the normal case for every non-catalogue member.

CID.description: Optional content identifier pinning the exact referenced record bytes.

ADDED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp the member was added.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this membership; never a substitute for a field.

GROUP_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the group. Together with the publishing
key it is the group's identity across versions.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of what the group collects.

TAGS.description:
`namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.
This is the ONLY classification surface: there are no folders.

QUERY.description: The generating query, when the group was saved from a search.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond update timestamp. With GROUP_ID and the
publishing key this is the version key: latest-wins per publisher.

PROVENANCE.description: Dataset lineage and licence for the assertions in this group.

DATASET_CID.description: Optional content identifier of the dataset the group was drawn from.
